title: 'Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu II' Unveils Supporting Cast, Main Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nana Mikoshiba 's Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu ( The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ) light novel unveiled supporting cast and the main promotional video for its second season on Thursday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Saga of Tanya the Evil II Anime Gets English Dub
content: Crunchyroll announced on Wednesday it will begin streaming an English dub for Saga of Tanya the Evil II ( Yōjo Senki II ), the second season based on author Carlo Zen and illustrato Shinobu Shinotsuki 's light novel series, on the same day.
author: ANN

title: Millennium Family TV Anime Casts Ryōta Suzuki
content: The staff for the television anime of Sho Kasugai 's Millennium Family ( Odoru Sennen Kazoku ) manga announced on Thursday that Ryōta Suzuki will voice the character Hugo, the second son of the Benfield family. The anime will air on TBS and other stations.
author: ANN

title: Resident Evil 2, 3, 4 Remake Games Get Switch 2 Digital Release on October 16
content: Nintendo announced during its Nintendo Direct presentation on Wednesday that CAPCOM will release the Resident Evil 2 , Resident Evil 3 , and Resident Evil 4 remake games on Switch 2 via the Nintendo eShop on October 16, with physical releases coming for the games on January 29.
author: ANN

title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 Game's Switch 2 Edition Highlights New Character, New Mode in Video
content: Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that the Switch 2 edition of Xenoblade Chronicles 3 RPG will feature a new Heroes' Vault mode, and a new character Shimmer. The Switch 2 edition launches on December 3 physically and digitally.
author: ANN

title: Cygames Is Now a Premium Partner to the Qatar Prix de L’Arc de Triomphe
content: Cygames, Inc., the company behind the Umamusume: Pretty Derby franchise, is now a Premium Partner to Qatar Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe. This partnership marks the first time a Japanese company has attained Premium Partner status with the prestigious race.
author: Anime Corner

title: Mari Okazaki's Will I Be Single Forever? Manga Gets 2nd Live-Action Film
content: The official X/Twitter account for the live-action film of Mari Okazaki 's Will I Be Single Forever? ( Zutto Dokushin de Iru Tsumori? ) manga announced on Thursday that the manga will have a second film titled Tenten Zutto Dokushin de Iru Tsumori?
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Sins of Kujo Film's Teaser Reveals More Cast
content: The official website for the live-action film of Shohei Manabe 's Kujō no Taizai (Sins of Kujo) manga began streaming a new teaser trailer for the film on Thursday. The teaser reveals more cast members for the film.
author: ANN

title: Xbox Game Studios Takes Over Publishing Hideo Kojima's Physint Action Espionage Game
content: Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) announced on Wednesday that it will no longer publish Hideo Kojima and Kojima Productions ' Physint action espionage game . On the same day, Microsoft 's Xbox Game Studios announced that it is taking over publishing for the game.
author: ANN

title: Tokyo Gap-Financing Market Highlights 5 Animation Projects Seeking More Funding
content: On Wednesday, TIFFCOM 2026 and the Tokyo International Film Festival highlighted 24 film projects, including five animated ones, that the 7th Tokyo Gap-Financing Market (TGFM) event will feature on October 28-30.
author: ANN
